RemediationStrings.Title: asca hasn't produced a report on this device
RemediationStrings.Description: The daily asca audit isn't installed or hasn't run. Ask IT to (re)install the scheduled asca job.

RemediationStrings.Title: The last asca audit is {ActualValue} hours old
RemediationStrings.Description: The scheduled asca job stopped running (limit: 48 hours). Make sure the device has been on and logged in, or ask IT to check the job.

RemediationStrings.Title: asca found {ActualValue} critical issue(s) on this device
RemediationStrings.Description: Open the asca report or dashboard on this device and follow each fix, or contact IT.

RemediationStrings.Title: asca found {ActualValue} high-severity issue(s)
RemediationStrings.Description: Open the asca report or dashboard on this device and follow each fix, or contact IT. Accepted risks go in asca's baseline file and stop counting.
